duration.text: The Environmental Science at An Hui Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Photocopy of awards certificate

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 35, and is in good health, preferably with a Bachelor’s Degree or above. Certified academic records and 2 letters of recommendation by 2 associate professors are required. The HSK score should reach level 4 or above.
